tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun a ra pa tsa'i rjes gnang byed tshul gcig shes kun khyab bzhugs so// sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i a ra pa tsa na la rgyas par na lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang / bsdus na gtso bo rkyang pa'i rjes su gnang ba gnyis las/ da res rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol bzhin/ rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dgos pa 'khor dang bcas pa da res nas kyi gnas skabs su song nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs gnyis su med pa la rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rjes gnang bstsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad par zhu/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas/ rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa dang / rjes gnang dngos gnyis las/ thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/

slob dpon la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung ba byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyi oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis tha mal gyi snang ba mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo dhīḥyig gser btso ma'i mdog can/ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes sogs sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed/ slar yang slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon gyi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku'i rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par byon nas/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams su thim pas/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥsogs dang / a be sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa lan gsum la sogs pa bya/ de rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa yin/ rjes gnang dngos la/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung dam bca' ba'i lung / byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung rnams su yod pa las/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams dang slob dpon gnyis ka'ang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar g.yas su dhīḥ g.yon du a rtsibs bzhi la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ ra/ pa/ tsa/ na/ zhes pa rnams 'khod par mos nas/ slob dpon la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud byas pas/

slob dpon gyis thugs kha'i dhīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung / slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying kha'i dhīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la/ dang pos thim/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes dang / slar yang khyed rang rnams dang / slob dpon gnyis ka rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i lce'i steng du dhīḥyig dmar ser mgo gre phugs su bstan pa re re yod par mos pa mdzad nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon gyi dhīḥyig las dhīḥyig dpag tu med pa byung / khyed rang rnams kyi dhīḥyig la thim pas/ mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal nas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos nas dbugs thengs gcig la dhīḥbargya rtsa brgyad gsung mdzod/ dhīḥdhīḥdhīḥdhīḥzhes sogs brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos gsung bar zhu/ bcom ldan bdag gi bzung lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod/ /lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyi me tog phreng ba/ sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes lan gsum tsam brjod nas me tog slob ma la gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod/ /ces dang / dam bca' ba'i lung gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing / de'i gsang sngags kyang ci nus su bzla bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/

slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus da nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing / de'i gsang sngags kyang ci nus kyi bzla bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum/ yang me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i byin rlabs dang / nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur gcig ces brjod/ byin gyis brlab pa'i don du/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs dkar phog de'i thugs rgyud bskul/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam re byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying kha'i dhīḥyig la thim pas byin gyis brlabs te chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mos pa mdzad nas de'i ngang la cung zad gcig mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de rnams kyi rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi song nas de dag gi skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes su gnang ba gsan pas gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bla ma la lus longs spyod la sogs pa yon du 'bul zhing cha shas kyi longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du sogs lan gsum bya zhing / de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes su gnang ba gsan pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che ba mdzad par zhu/

bsod nams 'di yis thams cad sogs byed/ 'di'i rjes gnang byed tshul 'di nyid ni/ swa nāp+tā wā gen+d+ra s+yār+the ṣu bhū mi paṇ+ḍu ka lo tsa li khyātra/ rang gi tsha bo ngag gi dbang po'i don du sa skya lo tsas bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang byed tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
